items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, affiliate/advertising expansion, and rights outreach; conditional for ordinary reversible internal/read-only work; counsel_required for any exception involving Woot rights, privacy jurisdictions, vendor/DPA coverage, or future monetization. Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and preview-only. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access but not storage, derivatives, caching, public display, alerts, affiliate, or advertising rights; public terms restrict commercial/public data use. All four legal launch tasks remain open. Accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and security/release gates remain blocked. Fleet compliance is a technical baseline only: 36 pass, 19 fail, 6 unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. No go-live proposal is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are evidenced to closure; none is closed. Existing repository and privacy/cookie artifacts provide only partial coverage. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle containing the Woot field-level rights matrix, alert-data flow and retention table, deployed consent/GA4 configuration capture, and log/vendor/incident inventory. Do not send rights outreach, enable tracking, expand alerts, change the private gate, or request duplicate telemetry.

Legal review of launch_readiness.data_use_review: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked; current terms conflict with proposed public/commercial use, and written permission, field rights, provenance, freshness, correction, and takedown evidence are missing. Smallest next action: record an authoritative current API agreement or written permission and field-level rights matrix; human counsel must review any exception. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; missing data inventory, retention/deletion/correction workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only flow and retention table from repository/configuration. GA4 = evidence_needed; missing deployed consent/withdrawal capture, property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, vendor disclosure, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture current configuration and consent behavior without enabling new tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and mark counsel-required gaps.

Fleet triage: do not block ordinary reversible growth solely because telemetry is incomplete, but preserve existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. New public exposure, regulated or age-sensitive concepts, unverified affiliate claims, upstream-data reuse, or monetization changes require a fresh legal disposition and, where rights or jurisdiction are uncertain, human counsel. Revenue evidence remains limited to $4.92 aggregate unattributed Amazon commission for 2026-09-21; do not assign it to a site or claim ROI.
